description: Number and cheque-amount words: English (US, UK, Indian lakh/crore) — Spells out a number or a money amount in English words for a cheque, contract or invoice, for an agent that must write the amount in words next to the figures. Locales: en-US ("one hundred twenty-three"), en-GB ("one hundred and twenty-three"), en-IN (lakh and crore, "one crore twenty lakh"). With a currency it returns the integer words, the minor-unit fraction as digits over 10^exponent ("56/100"

amount.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

name: number-to-words
